header.title: Job application tracking
header.intro: All roles you applied to across career goals. Use AI Coaching for interview review and voice mock practice per role. Partner / exclusive roles update automatically; other roles use the status you set.

details.title: Application details
details.emptyBody: Open a career goal's Jobs and use Apply or Apply with referral.

card.autoDesc: Status advances from your apply time (referral → review → interviews → offer). Timing is simulated from hours since apply; use Refresh if the page has been open a while.
